verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no data-export feature, bulk export, or open-format download for leaving Stable. The API does let you search and retrieve MailItems, including scan image URLs and OCR result URLs, and list companies and locations. Those are developer building blocks for building your own export, not a first-party export capability. "Your address is yours to keep" and change-of-address guidance concern address portability, not data export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
